posts.title_en: If Accuracy/Focus are a scam, share conquest gear with stages, not arena?
posts.summary_en: Proposes sharing one gear set between conquest and stages: weapons Skill AMP + crit, accessories Skill AMP + crit / DMG reduction + Skill Haste, armour CRIT RES + DMG reduction. Comments argue CRIT RES is dead in stages but kept on armour because it raises power more than flat stats; a long-time bottom-of-35% pusher says CRIT RES / DMG red / Skill Haste / Accuracy-Focus is all you need, Skill Haste above Accuracy/Focus for heal rotation.

builds.gear: weapon (sword/bow/staff): Skill AMP + crit; accessory: Skill AMP + crit / DMG reduction + Skill Haste; armour: CRIT RES + DMG reduction fixed
priority: CRIT RES / DMG reduction / Skill Haste / Accuracy-Focus
builds.why: ㅇㅇ 3 (bottom-of-35% pusher): Skill Haste matters more than Accuracy/Focus because heal rotation is critical; buffer cookies already supply crit/Skill AMP/ATK

mechanics: CRIT RES on armour is a power (투력) stat: flat DEF/HP subs drop team power sharply, so CRIT RES is chosen for power even though bosses may not crit.
